# AC Server Manager 0.6 Preview

## Changes

- Recover application preferences from the last valid backup and save them through an atomic file replacement. Unchanged preferences are not rewritten.
- Request normal server shutdown first. Offer a separately confirmed forced stop only if the server does not exit; Cancel leaves it running. Keep each managed server in its own hidden console so stopping one does not affect another.
- Distinguish local readiness, unconfirmed startup, stopping and unexpected exits. Validate `/INFO` for the selected track/layout instead of accepting any successful HTTP response.
- Reject duplicate launches, cancel startup checks when stopping and retain the final output on exit.
- Keep the interface responsive under large output bursts, bound log history and line length, and add a **Follow log** switch.
- Save manager errors locally and add **Save report** for a text diagnostic report with known secrets and selected local paths redacted. No automatic upload is performed.
- Add isolated process lifecycle and failure tests to the Windows CI workflow; no installed game is needed for those checks.

## Download and run

Extract **ACServerManager-0.6.0-preview-win-x64.zip** completely into a writable folder and run **AssettoServerManager.exe**. The Windows x64 package includes .NET; keep the other files alongside the EXE. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the archive checksum.

Bring your own game content and Content Manager. Existing servers remain in your chosen folder. Saving does not restart a running server. Local readiness does not confirm internet access or a successful game connection. Review exported reports before sharing because arbitrary plugin output may contain private information beyond recognized fields.

See `RELIABILITY.md` for test instructions and remaining limits. Application: MIT; bundled runtime notices are in `licenses/`.
